flow.clock_qualification: none; wall_valid is false on all producer records

diagnostic_arithmetic.group_additions_m64: Sum of the frozen per-cell prefix64 counter, across128 cells per arm. This is not the equal-curve geometric mean comparison.
diagnostic_arithmetic.whole_child_cpu_seconds: Sum of wait4 user_seconds+system_seconds over128 children per arm; includes common validation, parsing, solver, output and teardown. Clocks are unqualified operational diagnostics.
diagnostic_arithmetic.maximum_child_maxrss_bytes: Maximum of128 recorded whole-child Linux wait4ru_maxrss values, each converted fromKiB tobytes by sourceA. Not an endpoint-arena or physical-host isolation attestation.
